name: Spanish Common Words Set 18
description: This is part of a larger set of common Spanish words, focusing on vocabulary not included in previous sets.

cards.sentence: Todos van a aplaudir el final de la obra.
cards.sentenceTranslation: Everyone is going to applaud the end of the play.

cards.sentence: El aroma del café recién hecho llena la cocina.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The aroma of freshly brewed coffee fills the kitchen.

cards.sentence: El brillo de las estrellas en el cielo era increíble.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The brightness of the stars in the sky was incredible.

cards.sentence: La textura de la seda es muy suave.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The texture of silk is very soft.

cards.sentence: Su voz hizo eco en la cueva oscura.
cards.sentenceTranslation: His voice echoed in the dark cave.

cards.sentence: Escuchamos un silbido lejano en la noche.
cards.sentenceTranslation: We heard a distant whistle in the night.

cards.sentence: El crujido de las hojas secas era fuerte.
cards.sentenceTranslation: The crunch of the dry leaves was loud.

cards.sentence: Prefiero beber mi leche tibia por la mañana.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I prefer to drink my milk lukewarm in the morning.

cards.sentence: No puedo evitar bostezar cuando tengo sueño.
cards.sentenceTranslation: I can't help but yawn when I'm sleepy.

cards.sentenceTranslation: I need to cough to clear my throat.

cards.sentenceTranslation: I like to wink to greet my friends.

cards.sentenceTranslation: She usually frowns when she's concentrated.

cards.sentenceTranslation: He had his brow furrowed while reading the complicated document.

cards.sentence: No puedes pestañear durante este juego.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You can't blink during this game.

cards.sentence: No debes morder las uñas, es un mal hábito.
cards.sentenceTranslation: You shouldn't bite your nails, it's a bad habit.

cards.sentenceTranslation: Chewing food well helps digestion.

cards.sentenceTranslation: It was so big that it was hard for him to swallow.

cards.sentenceTranslation: Eating slowly improves digestion.
